description: Sharp and unique extremum among unitary totient-practical integers with exactly six distinct prime supports.
integrity: Arithmetic equalities and prime factorizations checked by a standalone standard-library program; infinite assertion follows from an exact prefix lemma and inequality. No external audit was conducted.
scientific_limitations: Does not classify all six-support cases or compute seven-support maxima; an unindexed equivalent extremum may exist.
title: Sharp six-support maximum for unitary phi-practical integers
